author: V. H. Sonawane, V. S. Parekh and K. N. Momin, Department of Archaeology and Ancient History, M. S. University, Baroda (under R. N. Mehta)
asr_identification: Valabhi (Bhavnagar district): sites Nesadi and Maya-no-Khado
evidence: 1979-80: Nesadi a Harappan single-culture site; Maya-no-Khado one period in three phases: I (1st c. BC/AD-4th c.) amphorae, Red Polished Ware; II (4th-5th c.) brick structures, rammed floors, iron furnaces; III (5th-8th c.) beaten-earth floors and walls of reused bricks, a gold ring with an intaglio
quote: conducted excavation at Valabhi, the capital of Maitrakas who once ruled Saurashtra in Gujarat and parts of Malwa for about three centuries from A.D/480 to 790 … Phase III (fifth-eighth century A.D.) is marked by some floors made of well beaten earth and structural remains of reused bricks.
note: Valabhi = the Maitraka capital (11.08) as Mizutani and the study (secure, Vala near Bhavnagar). Phase III covers Xuanzang's visit but gives only poor floors; none of his hundred monasteries; no inscription naming the place in the report.
